behaviors.behavior: AC35: a session-scoped Codex model override reaches codex exec's argv, ranked ahead of the persisted project-config value
the session env var beats project config at the resolver level
an explicit --codex-model flag still beats the session env var
plan_review reads its own env var (SHIPWRIGHT_CODEX_PLAN_REVIEW_MODEL) and never the spec/code/doubt var, and vice versa
project config still wins over the hardcoded default when no env var is set
a blank or whitespace-only env var is treated as unset and falls through to config
a hostile model slug -- from any source, including the new env-var axis -- hard-errors before codex exec launches, and the reported reason never echoes the raw value
the role-to-env-var / role-to-config-key tables are checked for completeness against ROLE_SCHEMAS at import time, failing loudly rather than reaching a KeyError deep in resolution
the two new env vars do not leak between tests (ambient-env regression): with both exported at the OS level, the full affected test set still passes
